light-level-overlay.config.title: Light Level Overlay
light-level-overlay.config.keys_info: %s turns the overlay on and off. Keys are under Options > Controls > Key Binds > Light Level Overlay, including one (unbound at first) that switches between crosses and numbers.
Crosses: a cross wherever monsters can spawn.
Red: at any time. Yellow: only at night,
because the sky lights it by day.
Numbers: the block light level on every block
you can stand on, with every 0 in red.
light-level-overlay.config.show_water.to:
Marks on water where drowned can spawn.
Drowned spawn at any depth, so the mark on the surface
is for the darkest spot in the water below it.
In numbers mode, blue numbers are water that is lit enough.
light-level-overlay.config.show_night_sp:
Yellow crosses on dark spots under the open sky,
where monsters only spawn at night.
Turn off to see only the always-dark (red) spots.
Numbers mode shows every 0 in red either way.
light-level-overlay.config.numbers_face_:
Yes: numbers turn to read upright from wherever you look.
No: numbers stay fixed, with the top of the digits
pointing north, like on a map.
light-level-overlay.config.horizontal_ra: How many blocks out from you the overlay reaches.
light-level-overlay.config.vertical_rang: How many blocks above and below you the overlay reaches.
